text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry... I wasn't strong 
enough, I really am...
choice_data_list: Some races just don't go your way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I really hate the thought of... 
Trainer being looked down upon because of 
my losses.
choice_data_list: 上手くいかないレースだってあるよ

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The only reason we lost was because I was 
too weak...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I... don't want to lose anymore. To help 
my Trainer shine, I can't afford to 
hesitate any longer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Before this resolve wavers... Once more—I 
ask for your strict guidance, please—
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's figure out a way to win 
together.

together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...You are truly kind through and 
through, aren't you... Trainer?"
choice_data_list: もう一度、やり直そう。ふたりで

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why— I want to repay 
that kindness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Once more... I'll be in your care. Next 
time, I promise I'll deliver results.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Your guidance, 
Trainer-san, is truly reliable――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That is something—I believe I understand 
better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: That is why—I must make the most of it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my absolute best as well... So 
that next time—I can bring you victory.
